sentences.span: purchase commitments plus long-term supply obligations ... from ~$311B in FQ2 (and ~$145B in FQ1) to ~$430B
sentences.why: UBS gives the exact $311B (prior quarter) to $430B (current quarter) jump in Nvidia's supply/purchase commitments, matching the figures and the one-quarter ('three months ago') gap.

sentences.span: consensus has it reaching around $625bn by 2031 ... Nvidia is trading on around 6x those potential future earnings at its current market cap

sentences.span: The 3-month annualized pace of US core CPI hit 3.75% in October, the fastest since April 2024.

sentences.span: UBS's Tim Arcuri ... even a temporary pause ... could pull $50BN or more out of the AI ecosystem
